Combining his energetic delivery with competitors' structured frameworks (e.g. multi-agent setups, brand name-dropping) maximizes both reach and technical authority.
verdict.recommended_hook_structure: Stop [Paying for / Doing Action] right now. [Tool / Method] just released [Huge Free Benefit / Hack], and here's how to get it in 30 seconds.
verdict.recommended_body_structure: Show proof on screen -> Break setup down into 3 fast layers/steps -> Mention specific impressive metric/token count -> Offer shortcut.
verdict.recommended_cta_structure: Comment '[KEYWORD]' below and I'll send you the exact prompt + complete setup workflow right to your DMs.
avoid_these: Vague personal rants without tangible takeaway value for the viewer
Antagonizing the audience directly ('I don't care about you')
Listing tools without showing screen proof or explicit usage numbers
